behaviors_asserted: c.header() writes into the private #preparedHeaders and does not set finalized
c.res getter allocates by creating a Response instance and materialises #res
Reading c.res is not a neutral inspection — it changes the response (header() writes into #res.headers and text() loses its fast path)
There is no public way to check for or read pending response headers without materialising a Response
text() uses an internal predicate: !this.#preparedHeaders && !this.#status && !arg && !headers && !this.finalized to take a fast path
